positions.title: Senior Software Developer, Production Support
positions.locationName: New Hampshire and Greater Pittsburgh Area
positions.description:
Responsible for helping to develop, maintain and support internet based sourcing software. This includes programming (primarily in Perl), database management, data preparation, client support, and troubleshooting. I interact and communicate with client services, professional services and other groups for troubleshooting efforts.
*Built a reputation for being the go-to person to quickly resolve customer issues
*Sought after to assist in major development releases
*Counted on to always meet deadlines and reach goals

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Taught recitations/lectures to classes of up to 60 students in many different courses of computer science, including SQL/databases, logic theory, and computer ethics. Created and graded homework assignments and exams. Assisted in one-on-one tutoring with the
students.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description: Solely responsible for planning lectures, laboratory and homework assignments, quizzes and exams, grading, and presenting lectures for an introductory computer course. Objectives of this course included: (a) A non-technical study of the Windows NT operating systems; (b) Development of applications using software selected from the principal areas of applications for personal computing. These include word processing (Microsoft Word), spreadsheets (Microsoft Excel), and relational databases (Microsoft Access).

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: Created and maintained spreadsheets and databases of member and financial information, managed funds, general office duties, communication liaison for members and staff, and managed public relations and recruiting sessions with high school students and parents.
